questions.instructions: Using only the candidate_context profile and the job posting, judge how well the role matches what the candidate says they want. Judge the work itself, not the company or the location.

criteria.strong: The core work is squarely what the profile says the candidate wants.
criteria.plausible: The work overlaps with what the candidate wants or is open to, even if not a perfect match.
criteria.weak: The core work is something the profile excludes or does not mention at all.
criteria.unknown: The posting does not say enough about the work to judge.
